Name: Some Very Important Paintings
Author: asarigolo
Description:
Giant paintings of Shane; an essential that everyone should have in their Mod folders. There's also some chicken paintings but really they don't matter as much as Shane, heh?
(Or: At first it was a joke mod but then i got carried away. This is all the chickens' fault)

It's technically rugs because the game doesn't want us to have big paintings. Yeah. That means you can walk on those poor chickens if you want to (but please don't).
